'''Lafete''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories]] [[planet]] that included [[Factory|factories]] and the [[Port of Lafete]] [[city]] on its surface. There, the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]] and his associate [[Boba Fett]] met with the Mandalorian [[Nite Owls]] [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] and [[Koska Reeves]] to negotiate a [[Second rescue of Grogu|rescue plan]] of Djarin's [[foundling]], [[Din Grogu|Grogu]].

==Description==
Lafete was a terrestrial [[desert]] [[planet]] in the [[Tunka sector]] within an intersecting portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and the [[Western Reaches]].<ref name="Western" /> Situated at the coordinates I-18 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]],<ref name="Appendix" /> it was connected by [[hyperspace route]] to the astronomical objects [[Eiram]] and [[Sump]].<ref name="CLNE">''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]''</ref> Lafete had two [[moon]]s and was home to a number of [[Factory|factories]] on its surface<ref name="Chapter 16" /> and the [[city]] [[Port of Lafete]].<ref name="Mando Handbook">''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian Handbook]]''</ref>

==History==
In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The events of "[[Chapter 16: The Rescue]]" took place in [[9 ABY]] per the reasoning [[Template:MandoDate|here]].</ref> the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]] and his ally [[Boba Fett]] visited a local [[Lafete diner|diner]], where the Mandalorian [[Nite Owls]] [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] and [[Koska Reeves]] were seated. While Djarin intended to recruit the pair to help him [[Second rescue of Grogu|rescue]] his [[foundling]] [[Din Grogu|Grogu]] from the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Moff]] [[Gideon]], Fett was skeptical about the two Nite Owls and exchanged insults with them. The argument then led to a brawl between Reeves and Fett until Kryze stopped them both, agreeing to help Djarin with his mission.<ref name="Chapter 16" />

The group convened aboard Fett's [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft|''Firespray-31''-class patrol and attack craft]],<ref name="Chapter 16" /> ''[[Slave I]]'',<ref name="Slave I DB">{{Databank|boba-fetts-starship|''Slave I''}}</ref> outside of the diner to plan their mission with the rest of Djarin's allies and their [[prison]]er, the Imperial [[Doctor]] [[Penn Pershing]], before they departed to search for [[Gideon's light cruiser]].<ref name="Chapter 16" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lafete first appeared in "[[Chapter 16: The Rescue]]"<ref name="Chapter 16" /> of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[2019]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', directed by [[Peyton Reed]] and released on [[December 18]], [[2020]].<ref name="Insider 202">{{InsiderCite|202|Star Wars: The Mandalorian Season Two Companion|''Star Wars: The Mandalorian'' Season Two Companion}}</ref> The world was then identified in the [[2021]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian Handbook]]'', which was written by [[Matt Jones]].<ref name="Mando Handbook" />
